Name: Paisley's Bridal Boutique [GMM]
Author: Elaho
TagLine: Provides a temporary boutique for players to purchase formal hats, shirts, and pants. V 2.0.0: Now includes full animation/gameplay compatibility for all pants, skirts, and dresses!
Description:
Welcome to Paisley’s Bridal Boutique!

This mod is part of a larger mod-in-progress called “The Grampleton Maker’s Market” and features a bi-monthly temporary boutique where players can
purchase formal hats, shirts, and pants. Please note that this version of Paisley's Bridal Boutique is a demo version of the upcoming GMM mod expansion pack and only features a portion of what will be included in the main mod.

**UPDATE: Version 2.0.0 now includes full animation/gameplay compatibility for all pants, skirts, and dresses! Players can now wear their favourite outfits anywhere: farming, mining, fishing, dancing, getting married, and more! :)**


How to Make the Boutique Appear: (Light Spoilers)

Players must have upgraded their farmhouse to include a kitchen to have Paisley’s Bridal Boutique appear in the Town Square. After Robin has upgraded your house, you will receive a letter from Lewis explaining the Maker’s Market. You MUST have read this letter for the boutique to appear. After the letter has been read, Paisley will set up her shop every 6th, 7th, 20th, and 21st of each month (except winter) in the Town Square. The shop will be open from 9 AM to 6 PM regardless of the weather.

PLEASE NOTE: This mod package requires the [MFM] The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter [beta] which must be downloaded from the official Grampleton Maker’s Market Letter (demo) page.

Paisley’s Bridal Boutique features a variety of wearable items that are always available for purchase, as well as a rotating stock of seasonal and cultural formal wear. Photos attached include some (but not all) available clothing and accessories. All outfits are available for both male and female farmers to wear. 

[UPDATED v. 2.0.0+]**Important Notes about the Outfits** (PLEASE READ)

﻿1. Hats have been adapted to fit most hairstyles, but not all hairstyles will 'fit' properly with each hat. Some hairstyle adjusting (through the Wizard's mirror ﻿or other appearance-changing mods, etc.) may be required.

﻿﻿2. All outfits will work with multi-player and farmer-to-farmer marriages, but each player must install this mod package (and all required mods).


Mod Requirements and Compatibility [v. 2.0.0]:

The following mods must be installed for Paisley's Bridal Boutique to work properly:
-- Content Patcher
-- SMAPI
-- The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter [GMM]

This mod is compatible with Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded maps but hasn’t been tested with other map-editing mods.


How to Install [v.2.0.0]:

As of version 2.0.0, 'Paisley's Bridal Boutique' now only contains 1 file folder [CP Paisley's Bridal Boutique]. All previous folders are no longer compatible with this mod and must be deleted for this mod to work properly with 1.6. Please delete any old boutique folders before installing the latest version. 


Donations

Paisley's Bridal Boutique is a free expansion pack for The Grampleton Maker's Market and features a variety of new content to enhance your Stardew Valley experience. With regular content updates, bug fixes, and transparent communication with the community, developing the Market to its full potential and adding additional shops, characters, and content takes a lot of time.

Please consider donating to me through Patreon. 

The Future of this Mod (and the Grampleton Maker’s Market):

Q: Will shop owners become NPCs?
﻿Plans are being made to add more artisans to the Grampleton Maker’s Market, as well as turn the shop owners into interactable NPCs with their own backstories and heart events. Plans are also in the works to include future items in CC bundles for players who want a more challenging playthrough.

﻿Q: Will more outfits be added to this mod?
﻿No new wedding outfits will be added for the foreseeable future, and I will not accept any requests for further additions.
﻿However, I am open to adding outfits on a commission basis only and at my own discretion. Please PM me for rates and details.

﻿Q: Is this mod available in other languages?
The current version [v.2.0.0] is only available in English, but translations are welcome and will be implemented in future updates. Please PM me if you would like to provide translations for the current 2.0.0 version, as my translation policies have changed. 

﻿Q: What Nation is Paisley from?
Paisley is Celtic-Canadian (Scottish-Irish-English) from the Canadian Maritime Provinces (New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, and Newfoundland + Labrador). Stardew Valley is set in a fantasy world, so I've decided that Paisley will be from the "Elyrian Commonwealth", a fantasy nation based on Atlantic Canadian culture.
